name: Shuham
title: Son of Dan and clan founder
summary: Shuham (also called Hushim) was the son of Dan, who was the son of Jacob and Bilhah. He is the ancestor of the Shuhamite clan among the tribe of Dan. Although little is written about him personally, he played an important role as the founder of one of the clans in Israel's tribal organization.

keyEvents.title: Born as son of Dan
keyEvents.description: Shuham was born as the son of Dan, Jacob's fifth son. In Genesis he is called Hushim.

keyEvents.title: Recorded as clan founder
keyEvents.description: In the census on the plains of Moab, Shuham (the ancestor of the Shuhamite clan) was counted among the descendants of Dan who formed the Shuhamite clan.

keyEvents.title: The tribe of Dan in the census
keyEvents.description: The Shuhamite clan was counted in the census, and the tribe of Dan numbered 64,400 men of fighting age.

keyEvents.title: Jacob travels to Egypt with his family
keyEvents.description: Shuham (Husjim) was among Jacob's descendants who went down to Egypt during the famine, as part of Dan's family.
